briefings.title: Barclays CEO CS Venkatakrishnan Talks AI Development & Inflation | Bloomberg Talks
briefings.tldr: Barclays CEO CS Venkatakrishnan warned that persistent inflation, rising global debt-to-GDP ratios, and heavy tech-related debt supply are pressuring bond markets, while emphasizing that AI serves as an efficiency tool requiring workforce reskilling rather than a total replacement of fundamental banking infrastructure.
